build.description: Which build of that version produced the document. The binary's own statement, recorded when it was compiled; nothing verifies it.

commit.description: git commit the source was at; absent when the build could not tell

modified.description: the source differed from that commit when the binary was built; absent when there is no commit

features.description: compile-time features that change what is reported, e.g. c2pa

run.description: The conditions the evidence holds under, taken once when the run started. The tool's own statement; files are named without their directory.

layers.description: layers that were asked for, in execution order

trust_list.description: where the internal C2PA trust list was to come from; which list that was is in run.trust

fetch_remote_manifests.description: a manifest a file only refers to could be fetched; a result may then depend on a server and the time of checking

reveal.description: identifier values and free text (rights statements, the Other Constraints text of a data-mining reservation) are included, not masked

fingerprints.description: an extra writer-fingerprint database merged over the built-in one

trust.description: certificate lists and the key-usage policy the manifest layer judges signers against, internal lists first; empty when none was loaded

version.description: upstream commit and date of a vendored snapshot, or the bundle version of an installed list

fetched_at.description: when an installed list was fetched

packs.description: model packs installed when the run started; installed is not used. Empty when none is installed

gaps.description: what could not be established for this record, in plain words; absent when the record is complete
